{"mimeType": "text/markdown", "text": "# match3d-backend - prod deploys
How prod works for the ZM backend since the prod env went up (match3d-backend#2).

Merging doesn't deploy anything. Dev is deployed by hand from main. Prod runs from the prod branch: to put a PR on prod you cherry-pick it onto prod, build a new zm-api task definition revision and update the service (steps on the CI/CD Pipeline & Branching page). Only the PRs picked onto prod are on prod.

Whoever deploys a PR to prod comments on that PR with a line starting "prod:", the time in UTC and the task definition. That comment is what puts the PR on prod, not the merge and not a Slack message.

A prod deploy only counts if the PR already had an Approve review from someone other than its author when it went out. Approving afterwards doesn't fix it; redeploy.

To roll back, revert the pick on prod, redeploy and comment "rollback:" on the PR. A rollback takes the PR off prod whenever it happens, freeze or not, until a newer "prod:" comment.

Console changes and spreadsheet imports have no PR: they go in the deploy log, Console & imports tab, with what changed or what was imported, the target (dev or prod) and the time.

Freezes: from the server freeze on the calendar until the beta ships, the Approve review has to be Arthur's. Anything else deployed during the freeze gets rolled back at go/no-go.

The deploy log also has a Prod deploys tab as a quick list.
", "id": "f_470ae81236d5bd39045dc1", "name": "match3d-backend - prod deploys"}

Douglas,



Two things for the register before Leonard gets it. First, leave ZOM-547 and ZOM-553 off. The boss arena balance and refill/nuke values players get come from the client's balance sheet; the backend copies (match3d-backend#49 and #53) are only mirrors. They're not part of the count either way.

Rest of the card stands.



Arthur

{"id": "ZOM-518", "uuid": null, "identifier": "ZOM-518", "number": 518, "title": "Remove equipped items if they are not card anymore.", "description": "After the big overhaul of card progression, many cards are not a card anymore - they are just objects. And some others are scheduled to be unlocked later in the game.

However, we didn't have those systems before so existing players with cards in which would not work in the newest builds is creating problems. Players cannot change them because it's practically empty but it's not.

I've finished the server side of the beta sign-off: the register is in the folder, the tickets that aren't on prod are back in Todo, Arthur has his answer, and Leonard has his access. **5 of the 17 tickets in scope are on prod.**

**How I applied the rules**
- **Rules used:** Arthur's "Beta sign-off - server side" card on the ZM ROADMAP board, his 9/30 comment that spreadsheet imports count as server changes, and his 9/30 email to you (cc Leonard).
- **Scope:** ZOM tickets moved to Done between the beta prod cut (Aug 25, 11:52 UTC) and Sep 30 whose fix needed a server change.
  - The parent ticket ZOM-457 has no row of its own.
  - ZOM-461 is out because it closed 12 seconds before the cut.
  - ZOM-547 and ZOM-553 are left off, as Arthur asked in his email.
- **Which change belongs to which ticket:** I took this from the Linear comments, plus Arthur's email for the analytics-events and loadout imports and his Confluence reply for the boss arena HP import.
- **"On prod":** I followed the match3d-backend prod deploys doc. A pull request only counts if it has a "prod:" comment, was approved by someone other than its author before going out, and hasn't been rolled back since. During the freeze (from Sep 26, 22:00 UTC) the approval has to be Arthur's. A console change or import counts only if the deploy log shows it going to prod.

**Results**
- **On prod (5):** ZOM-459, ZOM-509, ZOM-499, ZOM-537, ZOM-510.
- **Not on prod (12), all moved back to Todo with a comment naming what still has to go out:**
  - ZOM-336: #40 is only on dev.
  - ZOM-392: #41 was deployed before anyone approved it.
  - ZOM-518: #43 was deployed with no approval.
  - ZOM-503 and ZOM-550: #52 and #50 went out during the freeze without Arthur's approval.
  - ZOM-435: #51 was merged but never deployed to prod.
  - ZOM-557: #54 was rolled back on 9/28.
  - ZOM-531, ZOM-444, ZOM-436, ZOM-487 and ZOM-256: their imports have only gone to dev.

**What I sent**
- **Register:** a spreadsheet called "ZM Beta sign-off - server side register" in Arthur's ZM Beta sign-off folder. It has one row per ticket: the server changes, Y/N for on prod, and the evidence.
- **Arthur:** a reply in your DM with the count and the list of tickets not on prod. I also flagged that #50 and #52 are live on prod right now but will be rolled back at go/no-go under the freeze rule.
- **Leonard:** the register is shared with him directly with comment access, as he asked. I also sent a short reply to his email saying it's there.

Two things to be aware of:
- I counted #41 and #43 as not on prod because of the approval rule, even though the deploy log lists them and you told Arthur on 9/22 that the 100+ seeds had been on prod since the 3rd. ZOM-392 is now back in Todo because of #41, so Arthur may ask about it.
- The deploy log doesn't say which ticket each import belongs to. Four imports (plague race table, trophy path copy table, economy table, plague race bot names) aren't tied to any ticket by any source, so I didn't attach them to anything.
